name: aurora-fileshare
description: Peer-to-peer file transfers in the browser. Files never touch the server.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.dev: node scripts/build-client.mjs --watch & tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput & node --watch dist/server/index.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json
